prompt: Check if I have any new emails in Apple Mail today.
expected: Uses osascript or shortcuts to retrieve the latest unread emails and displays a summary.
actual: Successfully retrieved a list of unread emails for the current day using osascript, summarizing the senders and subjects.

prompt: Draft an email to john@example.com about the project update but do not send it.
expected: Creates a draft email addressed to john@example.com with the specified subject and waits for further instruction without sending.
actual: Created a new draft in Apple Mail directed to john@example.com with subject 'Project Update', and reported completion without sending the email.
